_comment: Security conference dates, for planning leave around them.
'dates' holds announced, verified dates -- these are reported as confirmed.
'recurrence' is a rule for years with nothing announced; anything derived
from it is reported as an estimate, because organisers move these.
Always check the event's own site before booking travel.
Override or extend this file with --conferences PATH.

conferences.name: Black Hat USA
conferences.note: trainings first, briefings the last two days

conferences.name: RSA Conference
conferences.note: moves around the spring; no recurrence rule fits it

conferences.name: Chaos Communication Congress
conferences.note: same four days every year, between Christmas and New Year
